summary: v24 Nexus Instance Director regression: 11/11 backend endpoint tests PASS (public info, /join basic + 1.5s duplicate 429 + 2s recovery, /join invalid instance 409, /invite create + join success + garbage token 410, /instances/realm 428/200 + non-founder 403, /party/reserve size=3 200 and size=99 clamped to 200, /presence/friends 200). Frontend: landing /nexus renders hero, ENTER NEXUS CTA (nexus-enter-btn), avatar card, no horizontal scroll at 1920x1080 or 390x844. World entry with nexus_bloom=off + nexus_gfx=low: play-shell + HUD (exit, map-btn, settings-btn) mount, window.__NEXUS.models.loaded=16 tier=low, HUD shows zone + green dot + online count. Map overlay opens with SVG. HUD exit returns to landing. /nexus/nexus-central also loads landing. /games shows exactly 1 ENTER NEXUS CTA. /admin/nexus loads for stealth. Meshy balance untouched (no generation endpoints hit).

ui_bugs.issue: Second click on nexus-map-btn did not remove nexus-map-overlay from the DOM (overlay node still queryable). It may still be visually closed via CSS, but the toggle-close behavior is not fully verified. Recommend main agent verify visibility state.

action_items: Optional: confirm nexus-map-btn toggles overlay closed (removes/hides overlay) on second click; current test found overlay node still present.
critical_code_review_comments: nexus.py uses process-local dicts _last_join / _last_presence for rate limiting — will not work correctly across multiple worker processes/pods. Consider Redis or DB TTL for scale.
nexus.py routers/nexus.py is 870 lines — over the 700-line guideline. Split into join/invite/realm/party/presence sub-routers.

party/reserve silently clamps size to 8 for any large value (e.g. 99). Consider returning 400/422 when caller sent an obviously bogus size (>32) so clients notice the misuse rather than getting a smaller party than requested.

success_rate.frontend: ~95% (all critical HUD/world/landing flows pass; only minor open question on map overlay close)

test_credentials: stealth / Password1$ (founder), auditcheckreal / Password1$ (buddy/non-founder). Both worked.
seed_data_creation: Created realm instance realm_slug=test-realm-qa (via /api/nexus/instances/realm). Created nexus_invites tokens (900s TTL, auto-expire). Party reservations (60s TTL). No Meshy generations, no world mutation beyond nexus_instances + short-lived reservations.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression file test_nexus_instance_director.py can be re-run any time (idempotent). It relies on stealth being founder and auditcheckreal existing. World tests require setting localStorage nexus_bloom='off' + nexus_gfx='low' BEFORE entering /nexus, then waiting up to 60s for models. Meshy balance remains at 4456 per instructions (never called generation endpoints). Everything green.
